g.text: GDHUB-124 — the checkpoint's calendar, the subscription and Add to calendar
All dates of a checkpoint (one place, on the server)
Add to calendar on one call (12.08.17)
From the start day, the calls as booked and the checkpoint's own rules

text.tspan: With a person: calls 1–5 · sprint deadlines (days 7, 14, 21, 28)
· tasks may change after call 3 · evidence reminder (day 26)
· the verdict due (day 31) · for the curator: the AI's briefs
With the AI: the plan check (day 1) · reviews of sprints 1–3 (days 8, 15, 22)
· tasks may change after review 2 · the final review and verdict (day 29)

g.text: Shown as the viewer is: the author and the team, or the curator
Rows are sprints, columns their days; month named where it starts
A call or a review opens on click
Google · Apple · Outlook subscribe to it; 'Copy the link' for others
Built anew on every fetch: a moved call shows on the app's next refresh
Google · Outlook · an .ics file for Apple or any other app
The link opens without signing in: it carries only dates and titles, no notes or evidence
The link belongs to one person and one checkpoint; a stranger gets nothing without it
Times are instants; deadlines are whole days of the sprint, as the path shows them
Google refreshes subscriptions slowly (hours); the tab is always current
